description: Make a short siz.la address for a long web address. Returns the short address and the link's id. Safety checks run on every destination, and the account's monthly link limit applies. Password, expiry and click limits work on every plan, the free one included. It can also put the link in a campaign and fire the account's ad pixels on each click.

campaign.description: A campaign to put the link in, by name. A campaign that does not exist yet is made. Needs a paid plan.

code.description: A custom code for the short address, for example lunch-menu. Letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. Leave it out to get a random one.

cta_id.description: The id of one of the account's call-to-action messages (made on siz.la under Call to action) to show over the page the link opens.

destination.description: The full web address to shorten. It must start with http:// or https://.

domain.description: One of the account's connected custom domains, such as go.example.com, to make the link on. Leave it out to use siz.la.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working, as a date and time such as 2026-12-31 18:00.

password.description: A password visitors must enter before they are sent on.

pixels.description: Ids of the account's ad pixels to fire on each click, as listed by list_pixels.

title.description: A name for the link. Only the account owner sees it.

name: shorten_link
title: Shorten a link
